title: Sharp Detection of Jensen-Shannon Divergence between Categorical Potential Outcome Margins
banked_reason: D0.5.G grades the complete maximized package subfield at score ceiling 7.0 below the field floor 7.4; salvageable=false with no improvement directive. Independent validity gate confirms same-scope terminal downgrade.
gap_reasons: The contribution remains confined to one divergence, balanced assignment, and the dense growing-alphabet regime, without establishing a broadly reusable inference framework.
C=2^40 and the large mean-error envelope supply no useful moderate-sample power guarantee, while rational termination supplies no efficient-runtime guarantee.
Panel findings left unrepaired (the tier, not these, is the reason for the halt): calculation-error@thm:sharp-frontier-resolved, ballast@prop:design-reduction.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery developed the sharp log(2)/2 dense-alphabet Jensen–Shannon frontier, a finite-valid localized-entropy test, an exact labeled-record singleton converse and a one-sided shrinking-window bracket. Independent mathematical audits completed the informal argument, but D0.5 graded the narrow package subfield (7.0) below the field floor (7.4), with no same-scope improvement. Formalization was never started; the illustrative N=4 category-label reversal and unused design-reduction proposition remain disclosed prose cleanup, and boundary behavior plus optimal upper-window width remain open.
tldr: Balanced randomization of a fixed categorical roster has the sharp Jensen--Shannon detection constant \(c_{\mathrm{JS}}=\log2/2\) at scale \(K/N\). An exact labeled-record singleton obstruction gives maximin power \(\alpha=1/20\) below that constant, and one total observable score test has finite weak-null size at most \(\alpha\) and uniform power tending to one above it along every dense growing-alphabet sequence. A proved one-sided shrinking-window bracket reaches exact no-power through \(\lambda-\lambda/K\) and consistency above \(\lambda+\omega(1/\log K)\), where the excess tends to zero and \(\lambda=\log2/2\). The upper width is not certified optimal; boundary behavior and useful moderate-sample guarantees remain unresolved.
gap: Optimal iid two-sample \(\ell_1\) testing in CDVV and fixed-finite-support multinomial Jensen--Shannon inference in Stewart leave a different question: sharp maximin detection of the realized empirical causal margins of one fixed roster, with complementary missing potentials. Independent-sample entropy estimation and fixed-dimensional weak-null Gaussian inference also do not establish the all-occupancy frontier or finite weak-null calibration.
fill: A full-record lower certificate and an independently attaining balanced entropy score must match at an explicitly evaluated positive constant on every dense sequence. One total observable rule must satisfy finite weak-null size at each legal \((N,K)\). This field-tier objective concerns a sharp design-based inference frontier; it asserts no rate dominance over the different iid experiments.
